# Capture test fixture

These proposed Backstory and Ground truth files are the unchanged JSON from
the former `2026-08-23T182725+0800` synthetic capture scenario. Capture replay
and Ground truth reviewer tests use its one-candidate, ten-non-candidate Scene
mix. Validation still resolves the shared capture run configuration from
`synthetic-journal-evaluation/generation-presets/`.

This fixture is not an adopted evaluation dataset. Tests construct their own
temporary review records and reports. The complete original scenario is preserved
under `synthetic-journal-evaluation/scenarios/everyday-memory-capture--muse-provenance--2026-08-23/`.
